We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Lead the team that keeps Suno Corporate IT Systems running. As Senior Manager, IT Operations, you'll lead our IT Engineers and build our IT Service Desk. Your team owns IT operations across our four US offices — Cambridge, New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles — including identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration software, office A/V, office networking, and Tailscale.

Your success will be measured through the impact of your team. You'll establish clear ownership over operational areas, ensure top-notch service that your colleagues trust, and your team will leverage AI and Automation to scale efficiently. You'll partner closely with Operations, People, Finance, Security, and Engineering, and you'll be the senior IT presence on the West Coast.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/0fzLoGLLVcxm3uBA




WHAT YOUR TEAM OWNS

 - Identity and access management — Okta, SSO and SCIM coverage, joiner / mover / leaver automation via our IGA platform, access reviews, and ad hoc access requests.

 - Endpoint management — the Mac fleet in MDM, zero-touch enrollment, OS and patch compliance, device trust, and endpoint security in partnership with our EDR/MDR providers.

 - Collaboration software — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and the broader SaaS portfolio: configuration, hardening, licensing, and lifecycle.

 - Office A/V — conference rooms, videoconferencing, and event spaces.

 - Corporate Networking — wired, wireless, and WAN across four sites, including design for buildouts and expansions with outside experts where it makes sense.

 - Tailscale — our zero-trust network layer: ACL policy, device posture, access to internal tools and infrastructure, and the day-to-day administration in collaboration with Engineering

 - IT service delivery — the service desk, AI IT Service Management platform, SLAs, escalation paths, knowledge base, and the Tier 0 partnership with office managers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage the IT Engineers — set expectations against our role standards, give direct feedback, run 1:1s and performance conversations, and grow people on the IC track. Manage against outcomes and impact, not tenure and activities.

 - Build the IT Help Desk — define the service model (what the desk handles, what escalates to engineering, what office managers cover at Tier 0), write the job profiles, our our service desk team.

 - Own operational outcomes — the team's quarterly plan across the areas above, clear ownership of each area by a named engineer, and honest status reporting to the Senior Manager of IT and leadership.

 - Run change well — size changes by scope, impact, and reversibility; make sure the team communicates before changes land and can roll them back after; bring in the right partners early and avoid surprises.

 - Scale service as Suno scales — runbooks and knowledge articles good enough for AI-powered self-service to actually deflect; automate what the team has handled twice; absorb headcount growth without proportional growth in tickets or effort.

 - Manage vendors and partners — MSPs, network and A/V integrators, EDR/MDR providers, and SaaS vendors; hold them to results and know when to bring work in-house.

 - Lead IT for the West Coast — own IT for the SF office directly, oversee LA coverage, and partner with Facilities on buildouts, moves, and expansions.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - 10+ years in IT, including 3+ years managing IT engineers, a help desk, or an IT operations team at a high-growth company.

 - You've built a support function, not just inherited one — you can discuss service model, SLAs, staffing, and deflection you put in place and what changed because of it.

 - Working knowledge across the stack your team owns — identity (Okta or equivalent, SCIM, IGA), Apple-first endpoint management, Google Workspace and Slack administration, office networking and A/V, and zero-trust networking (Tailscale or comparable) — deep enough to set priorities, review your team's work credibly, and ask the right questions, without needing to be the best engineer in the room.

 - Strong people leadership — you've hired, coached, given hard feedback, and managed performance, including for people in other offices and time zones.

 - Clear written communication — you need to be able to communicate clearly and concisely for executive, business, and technical audiences.

 - Judgment under growth — you can tell a one-way door from a two-way door, move fast on the reversible, and slow down on the consequential.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Hands-on background with Okta, SCIM provisioning, and IGA tooling (Lumos, SailPoint, Saviynt, or comparable).

 - Modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud) and endpoint security partnerships (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Expel, or similar).

 - Tailscale or another zero-trust network layer in production — ACL design, device posture, SSO integration.

 - ITSM design experience — intake, categorization, SLAs, and reporting from scratch; AI-powered self-service a plus.

 - Experience running IT through a multi-office expansion — new sites, floor expansions, and the integrators and vendors that come with them.

 - Experience as an early IT leader at a company that grew from hundreds to a thousand employees.




WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from the San Francisco Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.




ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 25%) to lead team members and support offices across Suno locations, with a deliberate cadence in Cambridge and NYC during the first six months.




PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Office Coordinator, LA (contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're seeking a detail-oriented Office Coordinator to support our Workplace team and be the heartbeat of our LA office operations. As the first face visitors see and the go-to person for our team's daily needs, you'll create an environment where creativity and productivity thrive. This role combines the precision of facilities management with the warmth of hospitality.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same, bringing both meticulous organizational skills and a natural talent for making people feel welcome. From managing confidential documents to coordinating team experiences, your attention to detail and proactive approach will ensure our workplace supports our team's best work.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/2II3nDj637yNpta9

What You’ll Do

Administrative Management:

  • Process and maintain NDAs, waivers, and contracts

  • Serve as onsite coordinator for guests and candidates

  • Handle incoming/outgoing package shipments

  • Scan and distribute incoming mail to appropriate teams

  • Manage digital and physical filing systems

  • Serve as primary point of contact for vendors and service providers

  • Establish and negotiate partnerships with local hotels and vendors

  • Support visiting executives and special projects

Office Operations & Facilities:

  • Oversee office maintenance and promptly address facility issues

  • Maintain daily office cleanliness and organization

  • Manage security system including badges and camera monitoring

  • Manage onsite music studio, support partnerships team in hosting artists

  • Provide plant care and maintenance throughout the office

  • Monitor and stock food/beverage supplies

  • Coordinate daily lunch program including setup, service, and cleanup

  • Maintain office supply inventory

  • Process incoming and outgoing mail/packages

  • Manage guest and visitor access, including registration with building security

  • Oversee AV systems setup and troubleshooting

  • Coordinate device procurement and inventory

Team Experience:

  • Plan and execute team events and activities

  • Create a welcoming environment for employees and visitors

  • Support office culture initiatives

  • Support the talent acquisition team through onsite coordination

  • Support new hire onboarding

What You’ll Need

  • 1-2 years of experience in office management or facilities coordination

  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Experience managing vendor relationships

  • Proficiency with office management software and digital tools

  • Problem-solving mindset with ability to work independently

  • Detail-oriented approach with a proactive attitude

  • Comfort with dynamic environments and changing priorities

  • A love of music is a huge plus

Compensation:

This is an hourly position with a rate of $40-$45 an hour.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in person role working at our LA office

  • Contract: 6 months to start with the potential to extend or convert to full time.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

AI is changing how software gets built and how companies run, and we’re at the front of it. We're hiring a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to own direction and architecture on our AI Operations Engineering team. Suno is scaling incredibly fast and our job is to unlock growth for operations areas like music ops, support, legal, finance, and beyond with workflows, tooling, and intelligent agents.

What You'll Do

  • Build agents, workflows, and custom tools that let internal teams handle more without adding headcount

  • Evaluate and integrate third-party tools, making the call on what to buy and what to build

  • Contribute to and empower stakeholders on our self-service app deployment platform

  • Design and implement new patterns for internal APIs, auth and MCP building and extending beyond our Django monolith.

  • Integrate and scale customer experience systems built around third parties like Zendesk.

  • Partner with customer experience, legal, finance, people, and content ops to source new challenges

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • You bring 5–7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience

  • You have a proven track record of building, maintaining, and supporting internal tooling or systems that streamline engineering or business operations

  • You’re eager to learn and share agentic coding best practices and tools

  • You thrive in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where the problem space is still being defined

Nice-to-Haves

  • You’ve worked with agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) and eval or observability tooling (e.g. LangSmith, Braintrust)

  • You’re familiar with support tooling, CRM systems, or workflow automation platforms

Not sure you meet every point above? Please apply anyway! If you're excited about this work and think you could make an impact here, we'd love to hear from you. The best candidates rarely check every box.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure the cloud that runs Suno. That covers our Kubernetes clusters, the GPU compute behind our AI workloads, and the network that connects them. You’ll report to our Security Lead, work closely with Platform Engineering, and partner with AppSec engineers and our Detection & Response team as they grow alongside you. This is a building job. You’ll write threat models, set hardened defaults, and create paved paths that engineers actually want to use. Some of the work is familiar cloud security. Some of it, like securing AI infrastructure, is new for everyone.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/Utj2JDlLzR4Dvs3p

What You'll Do

  • Build Suno’s infrastructure threat model across cloud, Kubernetes, GPU compute platforms, and networking, and use it with the Security Lead to decide where to focus first.

  • Harden our EKS clusters, GPU compute environments, and infrastructure-as-code pipeline, including who can change infrastructure and how.

  • Design paved paths and secure defaults, such as trusted base images, network segmentation, and scoped access, and ship the fixes yourself rather than handing off a list of findings.

  • Define the infrastructure detections and alerts we need beyond out-of-the-box tooling, working with Detection & Response, and be the expert they call when those alerts fire.

  • Partner with Platform Engineering and the broader engineering org to land changes in a fast-moving environment, and help shape a growing Security team.

  • Protect the systems that let millions of people make music, so creative fulfillment can be part of everyone’s day.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • At least 7 years of experience in infrastructure security or adjacent fields.

  • An engineering background building secure-by-default tooling and paved paths, not primarily running scans and reporting findings.

  • Hands-on depth in cloud-native security (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure are fine), plus Kubernetes and container security, including image provenance and software supply chain security, or the ability to learn them quickly.

  • Strong enough coding skills to build your own tooling and implement fixes without needing another engineer to carry them out.

  • End-to-end ownership of security projects, with the comfort to build in a greenfield environment where structure is still taking shape.

  • A collaborative working style and genuine interest in learning how to secure AI infrastructure.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience rolling out a cloud security posture management (CSPM) platform.

  • Experience securing AI or GPU compute platforms, or serverless container environments.

  • Experience building or maintaining the pipeline other engineers use to deploy infrastructure-as-code, such as plan/apply approvals, state management, or policy checks.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

  • The annual salary range for this role is $276,960 - $363,510 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Suno exists to unlock the joy of making music. Millions of people use Suno to turn ideas into songs, and our platform generates music at a scale no moderation playbook was written for. We believe AI amplifies and empowers the people who make music, and keeping that ecosystem safe, fair, and trusted is core to the product, not a cost center bolted onto it.

Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/4IWNXlPv9MXDsCQe

The role

You will lead Trust & Safety Policy at Suno. Directly building and shaping our policies, you will also partner with PM, Eng, and Legal to understand the impact policies have on detection and remediation of violative content, fraud, bots, and identity issues, while also navigating music rights and our regulatory obligations. Generation volume grows faster than any human review model can, so we focus on policies that enable our enforcement systems to scale with the platform, hold it to a high degree of accuracy, and understand what decisions cost. You will report to the Head of Trust & Safety and partner regularly with Comms, Product, Engineering, ML, and Legal.

What you'll do

  • Own the Trust & Safety policy portfolio end to end: content and behavior policies, enforcement standards, and the policy roadmap as generation volume and product surface area grow.

  • Write policy that machines can enforce: translate principles into decision criteria, model thresholds and reviewer guidance that produce consistent outcomes at millions of generations per day.

  • Own policy for the hard genAI music problems: artist voice impersonation, rights-adjacent abuse, synthetic content disclosure and prompt-level misuse, in partnership with Legal.

  • Turn regulatory obligations (DSA, OSA and emerging AI-content regimes) into enforceable internal policy and audit-ready documentation, in partnership with Legal.

  • Run the policy development lifecycle: risk assessment, stakeholder review, launch guidance, enforcement calibration and post-launch measurement of policy effectiveness.

  • Set the escalation and edge-case framework: who decides what, on what timeline, with what precedent, so novel cases become policy instead of one-off judgment calls.

  • Publish externally when it counts: community guidelines, transparency reporting inputs, and policy explanations creators can actually understand.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering early so policy shapes features before launch rather than cleaning up after them.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years in trust & safety, platform policy, or integrity work, including 3+ years owning a policy domain at a UGC or generative AI platform.

  • A portfolio of policies you wrote that shipped and held up: you can walk through the risk assessment, the enforcement design, and what you changed after launch data came in.

  • Demonstrated experience making policy machine-enforceable: decision trees, model threshold input, labeling taxonomies or reviewer guidance that produced measurable consistency gains.

  • Fluency in the regulatory landscape shaping platform policy (DSA, OSA and emerging AI-content regimes) and a record of converting obligations into operational requirements rather than memos.

  • Working knowledge of music rights, IP or media licensing sufficient to write credible policy alongside Legal without needing them to hold the pen.

  • Evidence of moving Product, Engineering and Legal to adopt policy positions they did not start with.

  • Writing that operators, executives and regulators can each use: precise enough to enforce, clear enough to defend publicly.

Nice to have

  • Music, media, or IP-adjacent platform experience and fluency in rights-matching abuse patterns.

  • Direct exposure to DSA, OSA, or emerging AI-content regulatory regimes as operational requirements.

Compensation and benefits

$158,880- $200k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Suno's song creation agent is becoming something other teams build on. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you'll build the APIs, SDKs and shared tooling, including eval infrastructure, tracing and model routing, that let engineers across Suno ship agent features faster.   • Implement end-to-end tracing and observability, so any request can be followed across services from prompt to audio.

  • Manage model provider routing, fallback, rate limits and cost controls.

  • Partner with engineering teams across Suno to onboard them onto the platform with docs and hands-on support, and with Infra on the reliability and scale of the agent runtime.

  • Help more people turn ideas into music by making it faster and safer for teams across Suno to ship agent features.

Must-Haves

  • 4–6 years building and scaling backend or platform systems in production, in any language.

We’re hiring a Senior Lead of Physical Security to keep Suno’s people, offices, and events safe as we grow. You’ll build and run the physical security program, covering workplace safety, executive protection, travel and event security, investigations, and crisis response. You’ll work closely with People, Workplace, and Legal, and report to the CISO. It’s a hands-on role.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/faN7l6t0DB3tYxyt

What You’ll Do

  • Build and run Suno’s physical security program, including the policies, standards, site security plans, and metrics.

  • Lead executive protection, travel safety, and event security for leadership, employees, and the artists and creators we host.

  • Oversee access control, visitor management, monitoring, and guard force vendors across our offices, including budgets, contracts, and SLAs.

  • Run emergency response, business continuity, and crisis management planning.

  • Lead the physical security team and manage the contingent workforce, and partner with People, Workplace, Legal, and Security Engineering to build safety into how the company operates.

  • Protect the people building a platform that makes creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

  • 8–10 years of experience in corporate physical security, law enforcement, military, or a mix of these, with at least 4 of those years leading security teams and programs.

  • Hands-on experience with executive protection, guard force and vendor management, physical security technology, and workplace investigations.

  • A track record of supporting senior executives with discretion, tact, and good judgment.

  • Experience leading incident response and crisis management, plus working relationships with local, state, and federal law enforcement.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to brief leadership calmly when things are not calm.

  • Comfort thinking strategically while still doing the tactical work yourself.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building a physical security program from scratch at a high-growth tech company.

  • Background in event security for public-facing or high-profile events, such as concerts, festivals, or creator events.

  • Certifications such as CPP or PSP, or membership in groups like ASIS or InfraGard.

  • A bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, homeland security, emergency management, or a related field.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno’s company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $140K – $190K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

As our Sr. Staff Threat Intelligence Engineer, you’ll lead Suno’s work to understand and counter the adversaries targeting our platform, our users, and our business across security, trust & safety, and fraud. You’ll identify who is targeting Suno and how they operate, and turn that understanding into defenses across the company. Your analysis will shape how our security, T&S, and fraud teams prioritize risk and invest in protections. Your technical depth will make sure those recommendations hold up in our systems. This is a high-leverage role that will define how Suno anticipates and responds to emerging threats as the platform grows

What You'll Do

  • Investigate the threat actors and campaigns targeting Suno, from account takeovers and payment fraud to coordinated platform abuse, and connect activity across all three areas.

  • Analyze large-scale event and account data with Python and SQL to find patterns, link related activity, and size emerging threats.

  • Translate adversary tactics into concrete countermeasures, recommending detection, product, and architecture changes that engineering teams can build.

  • Brief security, T&S, and fraud leaders with intelligence ranging from quick situational updates to deeper strategic assessments.

  • Raise the bar for the team by setting standards for collection, analysis, and tradecraft as the threat intelligence function grows.

  • Protect the community creating on Suno, so making music stays safe, fun, and open to everyone

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in threat intelligence, with significant depth in at least two of security, trust & safety, and fraud.

  • Strong threat intelligence fundamentals: tracking threat actors, attributing campaigns to them, OSINT, and linking related accounts and infrastructure.

  • Hands-on data skills: Python scripting and SQL against large datasets to drive your own investigations.

  • Technical fluency in modern web and cloud architecture. You need to understand how an attack works and how to break it, without needing to ship production code yourself.

  • A track record of influencing engineering, product, and leadership teams that don't report to you, and turning findings into action

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with generative AI misuse, such as account farming, API or reseller abuse, or automated content abuse.

  • Background at a consumer platform or a company built on user-generated content.

  • Experience partnering with engineers to design detection rules and abuse signals.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms or graph analysis tools.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

  • The annual salary range for this role is $316,080 - $414,855 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno's product marketing function is at an inflection point. With a growing PMM team, we're now ready for a dedicated product marketing owner for our new, emerging bets. These are 0 → 1 products and features across the business.

You'll be the hands-on strategic PMM lead for emerging bets at Suno in a highly cross-functional organization. You'll support everything from defining the product strategy and roadmap with Product, UXR, and Design to leading the GTM strategy in partnership with Growth, Comms, and Brand. You'll own major launches and user journey work directly, shape how new users experience Suno, and raise the bar for how we do product marketing as a discipline.

Bets can span very different audiences. The right candidate will have created clarity from ambiguity and driven highly matrixed organizations to a central, measurable strategy.

This role is ideal for a seasoned PMM who ships impact through GTM strategies, loves being close to the work, and thrives in an ambiguous, rapidly-evolving environment.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/m8OAwnBeCMcrRF2m

What You'll Do

  • Define and own the emerging bets strategy, including how Suno moves a user from discovery to signup to first song and early repeat use.

  • Work closely with a core group of leaders to turn early ideas into clear bets, defining the audience and what success looks like before anything ships.

  • Lead GTM for 0 → 1 launches, from early tests and betas to full public releases.

  • Partner with Growth to design and run experiments that test demand and improve acquisition, activation, and retention for new products, bringing messaging expertise, user insight, and creative rigor.

  • Work with UXR and Data to map and optimize the new-user journey for new product areas. Identify the highest-leverage touchpoints and ensure messaging is consistent across all.

  • Serve as a cross-functional partner and thought leader with Product, Design, UXR, Growth, and Brand. Influence roadmap priorities through strong user and market insights.

What You'll Need

  • 8+ years in product marketing or related field, ideally with strong exposure to technology, music, or creative tools.

  • Proven track record owning GTM end-to-end for meaningful new product launches — from insight through execution and measurement.

  • Experience bringing growing adoption and engagement for new products, ideally in consumer apps

  • Experience working closely with Product, UXR, and Growth in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments.

  • Deep experience with top-to-mid funnel (acquisition, onboarding, activation, early habit) for a consumer, UGC, or subscription product.

  • Exceptional storytelling and writing skills – able to turn complex product work into clear, compelling narratives, copy, and launch stories

  • Analytical chops – comfortable setting success metrics, reading dashboards, and using data to refine strategy, journeys, and messaging.

  • Strong cross-functional influence – able to align Product, Design, UXR, Growth, Brand, and Creator/Artist partners around a single story and integrated plan without positional authority.

  • User-centric mindset – comfortable synthesizing UXR, data, and qualitative feedback into segment definitions, user journeys, and messaging.

  • Self-starter who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure where it doesn't exist.

  • Bias towards shipping and iterating vs. waiting for perfect information. Comfortable running experiments, learning fast, and implementing change.

  • Team-first, low-ego mindset – happy to roll up sleeves on everything from strategy to copy.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience on multi-platform products (web + mobile).

  • Prior work on subscription / monetization models or personalization / recommendation surfaces.

  • Deep personal passion for music – as a producer, player, or listener.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

Suno's product marketing function is at an inflection point. With a growing PMM team, we're now ready for a dedicated product marketing owner for our new, emerging bets. These are 0 → 1 products and features across the business.

About the Role

Suno is hiring its very first Director of Strategic Sourcing and Procurement. Suno is one of the fastest-growing AI-native companies in the world, and as our first sourcing hire your job is simple: get us better deals and ensure we’re partnering with the right vendors.

This is a multi-faceted, hands-on role: you’ll serve as a strategic partner to all of Suno’s teams in thinking through what technology strategy best meets our needs; be our primary negotiator across our non-headcount spend (cloud, inference, software, etc.); and build the systems that allow us to confidently manage vendor relationships and risks. You’ll decide when to move fast versus when to create healthy friction, partnering closely with Legal, Finance, and Security/IT to get deals done at the best price, terms, and flexibility.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/F9r6u4N4hN2a99w3

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with each of Suno’s business teams to define sourcing strategy: who are our key vendors, where do we have gaps where additional tooling could help, and where do we have unintended duplication or unused tools?

  • Partner with every team at Suno to forecast demand, understand technical requirements, evaluate suppliers, and translate our growth into sourcing leverage. Personally negotiate with major vendors and provide tools/techniques for anyone in the company to successfully manage spend.

  • Create intake and vendor contract systems that triage requests for new vendors, manage commitments, and surface renewals based on spend level, risk exposure, and usage. No surprise renewals of unused vendors, please!

  • Work closely with Security/IT and Legal to ensure that security review and legal term review are achieved for relevant vendors.

What You’ll Need

  • Must-haves

    • 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, and/or finops, ideally in high-growth technology companies

    • Experience negotiating directly with cloud providers and security/monitoring software with a history of demonstrated cost wins. Experience working with inference providers is highly desirable

    • Ability to partner with a wide variety of internal stakeholders. Can you ask the right question to diagnose over-provisioning of a costly service with the engineering team and also know which legal terms to focus on in an order form and MSA?

    • History of successfully deploying sourcing systems for better collaboration with internal teams and clarity on spend and usage

    • Collaboration, curiosity, and creativity. This not a role for someone who wants to slot into a defined process but rather someone who wants to reimagine what thoughtful sourcing and spend culture can unlock for a company

    • Comfort with ambiguity and high pace. You have a bias towards action over perfection and use AI to empower yourself and others

  • Nice-to-haves

    • Experience setting and managing budgets for office management and real estate buildouts

    • Work at both scrappy startups and scaled organizations. Help us make stage-appropriate decisions and tradeoffs as we grow

    • Experience building and maintaining AI-powered sourcing tools and playbooks for redlining, negotiation prep, benchmarking, and vendor reporting

    • Experience with readiness for IPO

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

  • The annual salary range for this role is $200,000 - $275,000 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company.

This is a high-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real-time personalization.

As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6

What You’ll Do

  • Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers.

  • Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models.

  • Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency.

  • Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality.

  • Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue.

  • Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable.

  • Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems.

  • Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms.

  • Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake.

  • Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way.

  • Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices.

  • Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform.

  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability.

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems.

  • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems.

  • Deep experience building and operating real-time streaming and batch processing systems.

  • Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML-powered product experiences.

  • Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems.

  • Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery.

  • Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality.

  • Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments.

  • A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices.

Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue.

  • Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including performance and cost optimization.

  • Experience with Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks.

  • Experience with dbt for transformations, testing, and modular data modeling.

  • Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working from our Cambridge, MA or New York, NY office five days per week.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $228,960 - 363,510 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on Suno’s new Bots & Fraud team, you’ll help lead the backend engineering behind our defenses against abuse, fraud, and bots. You’ll build real-time services that turn request telemetry, behavioral signals, and device and app attestation into enforcement, such as rate limits, challenges, and account actions, across every layer from the edge to product services. The team is new and pulls together work from across the company, so you’ll shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll report to the Bots & Fraud Engineering Manager.

Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/rieJJLO5xgUm2L0B

What You'll Do

  • Design and build backend services for real-time abuse, fraud, and bot defense, including rate limiters, challenge flows (CAPTCHA, proof-of-work, 2FA), rules engines, and account enforcement APIs.

  • Deploy defenses from the edge to product services, with detection and enforcement that’s easy to roll back, auditable, and low-friction for real users.

  • Build the logging and metrics that show what’s getting through, what we block, and our false-positive rate.

  • Protect high-value flows, including signup, login, payments, and song generation, from account farming, credential stuffing, card testing, and credit abuse.

  • Shape the new Bots and Fraud team's architecture, roadmap, and on-call practices, and raise the engineering bar for everyone around you.

  • Protect the people Suno is built for, so the platform stays a place where anyone can make music and that becomes part of everyday life.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience

  • 5+ years of backend development on distributed systems

  • 3+ years of experience in trust and safety, anti-abuse, or fraud prevention

  • 3+ years of technical leadership across a team

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, S3), Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Valkey/Redis

  • Experience detecting and stopping automated abuse of public APIs through request telemetry, rate limiting, and challenges

  • Experience building or running payments fraud and chargeback systems, whether built in-house or on third-party risk platforms

  • A track record of using AI to change how a team builds and operates, from development workflows to on-call and investigations

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances.
